capabilities: Show notes as a Keep-style card grid inside Obsidian
Capture notes, checklists, photos, voice memos and web clips
Organize cards with colors, labels, tags, pins and reminders
Import notes from Google Keep, Evernote and Apple Notes
Sync notes through JotDrop Cloud or any folder sync
disambiguation: Not a Google Keep client; notes are local Markdown files in your vault, and the cloud sync is optional.
extras: Free and MIT-licensed; the optional JotDrop Cloud has a free 250 MB plan and a paid Plus tier. Without the cloud there is no account, and sync is left to folder-sync tools (Syncthing, Obsidian Sync, iCloud, Dropbox). Ask JotDrop sends note text to a third-party AI service with your own key; on-device OCR downloads English/Dutch data once. Known issue: deleting many notes while a Syncthing device is offline can bring them back on reconnect.
intentEvidence: The free, open-source Google Keep alternative for Android, Obsidian, the web and Chrome
motivation: The author wanted Google Keep's fast, friendly cards without lock-in: "Keep the ease. Lose the lock-in."
problem: Obsidian has no card-grid quick-capture view, so fast jotting of notes, lists, photos and voice memos means leaving the vault for a service that holds your data.
